messages.author: 1c401082d2ed203e
messages.subject: errors after upgrade to ggplot2 0.8.8
parts:
I have been experiencing some problems after upgrading to ggplot2 0.8.8, with scripts that used to work fine, and have been able to reduce the issue to the test case below. This works fine with version 0.8.3, but on 0.8.8 gives an error on the second plot: “Error in class(output[[var]]) <- class(value) : cannot set class to "array" unless the dimension attribute has length > 0”.

I recognize that this specific case can be made to work with a simple “mydata$Group <- as.factor(mydata$Group)”, but it used to work without having to convert to factors. Is this a bug or an intended change in behavior (or am I doing something wrong)?

Thanks,
Yosef


## test case

mydata <- structure(list(Group = structure(c("AA", "AA", "AA", "AA", "BB",
"BB", "BB", "BB", "CC", "CC", "CC", "CC"), .Dim = 12L), Date = structure(c(14072,
14079, 14086, 14091, 14072, 14079, 14086, 14091, 14072, 14079,
14086, 14091), class = "Date"), Value = structure(c(1.07, 1.05,
0.98, 0.95, 1.04, 0.99, 1.13, 0.98, 1.3, 1.12, 1.25, 1.12), .Dim = 12L)), .Names = c("Group",
"Date", "Value"), row.names = c(NA, -12L), class = "data.frame")

require(ggplot2)
qp <- qplot(data=mydata, Date, Value, geom='line', facets=Group~.)
print(qp)
dev.new()
qp2 <- qp + geom_hline(aes(yintercept=1.0), colour='darkblue', alpha=0.3)
print(qp2)
